records.subject: You're in -- let's get Granite Systems set up
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone despite a welcome email [email:1f5ef25c], a held onboarding call [calendar:0a6cd86e], and a nudge [email:18ea1486] with zero customer replies. No tickets, so no visible blocker or engagement signal. Silence after a live call suggests low unaided momentum in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting your first Granite Systems project going
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks again for making time for our getting started call last week. Since then I haven't seen a project created in Wrenfield, and I'd rather that not be something you have to puzzle through alone.

For context, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting the first one in place is usually what makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a 15-minute call this week work? I can stay on while you set up that first project and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
